errors.text_span: Die blaue gestrichelte Linie repräsentiert die Importe
errors.evidence: In the figure, imports are shown as a solid blue line, not a dashed line. The dashed/vertical blue elements are the trade balance bars, not the imports.

errors.text_span: Die lila durchgezogene Linie repräsentiert die Exporte
errors.evidence: In the figure, exports are shown as a purple solid line, but the description also misstates the corresponding line style/encoding by pairing it with an incorrect overall visual mapping of series; the main issue is that the blue series is mislabeled and the chart does not use a dashed line for imports.

errors.text_span: Die blauen Balken repräsentieren den Handelsbilanzsaldo
errors.evidence: The blue vertical bars correspond to the trade balance on the right axis, but the description gives incorrect values and trend for them, including positive values around 150 to 150 at the end, whereas the bars are mostly near 0 to about -150 and end near roughly -170.

errors.text_span: Sie beginnt bei etwa 220 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2020, fällt leicht bis etwa 200 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2021, steigt dann bis etwa 300 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2022, bleibt bis 2023 relativ stabil und endet bei etwa 350 Milliarden US-Dollar.
errors.evidence: The blue imports line starts near 200 in 2020, dips to about 165, rises to around 290 in 2022, stays roughly in the 250–280 range through 2023, and ends near 345. The intermediate values and the 'relatively stable' description are inaccurate, especially the 2021 low and 2022 level.

errors.text_span: Sie beginnt bei etwa 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2020, fällt leicht bis etwa 140 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2021, steigt dann bis etwa 180 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2022, bleibt bis 2023 relativ stabil und endet bei etwa 190 Milliarden US-Dollar.
errors.evidence: The purple exports line starts around 135, falls to about 90 in 2020, rises to about 145 in 2021 and to around 180 in 2022, then fluctuates around 165–180 and ends near 180. The start, early dip, and end values are off, and it does not stay simply 'relatively stable'.

errors.text_span: Sie beginnen bei etwa 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2020, fallen bis etwa 100 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2021, steigen dann bis etwa 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2022, bleiben bis 2023 relativ stabil und enden bei etwa 150 Milliarden US-Dollar.
errors.evidence: The trade balance bars are near 0 around 2020, become negative, hover around -50 to -100 for much of the period, and drop to roughly -170 by the end. The values and direction are substantially incorrect.

The x-axis is described with years and tick spacing, but the description does not mention the exact axis label text as shown in the figure (only the unit appears in the title area, 'in Mrd. US-Dollar'), and it does not clearly describe the mixed dual-axis layout in terms of which series uses which axis beyond a brief statement.
